status: Mappings accepted by the user (October 9, 2026; notes still say 'REVIEW' where a judgement was made, see logs/_b12_xwalk_review.txt). Batch 12 utilities added October 9: Alberta electricity (wires and Rate of Last Resort) excluded until Phase 7C, Ontario/Alberta gas excluded until Phase 7D; PUC Distribution maps through the generic Ontario rules.
scope: Latest record per (utility_name, name, customer_class) by effective_date, as the site dedupes, with provenance 'live'. Provinces only; territories excluded (territory_planned_later).

matching.order: First matching rule wins; utility-specific rules precede generic ones; territories last.
matching.province: Two-letter code or null (any); the model province is the rule's, else the record's.
matching.fuel: 'electricity' | 'gas' | null, compared with the record's utility_type.
matching.match: All listed criteria must hold: tariff_code (exact), tariff_code_regex and name_regex (Python re.fullmatch on the whole string; also written with ^...$), customer_class, rate_structure.
matching.outcome: Exactly one of model {sector, structure, size_band} or exclude (reason from vocabulary.exclusions).
matching.adding_utilities: Append utility-specific rules before the territory rules and, within a province, before that province's generic ('*') rules; an empty match ({}) covers every record of the utility. Records with no rule are reported as unmapped by `python -m pipeline.representative_models --coverage`.

sectors.residential: Household service (single-family and individually metered dwellings).
sectors.commercial: Non-residential general service (commercial, institutional and building-related general facility service), banded by size; Ontario Large Use maps to commercial_xlarge.

structures.flat: One energy price (plus fixed charges); no demand charge, blocks or time periods.
structures.tiered: Energy price varies by consumption block (inclining or declining), no demand charge.
structures.tou: Clock-based time-of-use energy prices (including flat rates with time-of-day adjustments).
structures.tiered_tou: Tiered energy plus clock-based time-of-day adjustments (BC Hydro 1101 + 2101).
structures.ulo: Ontario RPP Ultra-Low Overnight time-of-use plan.
structures.critical_peak: Peak-event pricing: utility-called event hours priced high, other hours lower.
structures.seasonal: Energy price varies only by season (reserved; unused).
structures.demand: Billed on peak demand (kW or kVA) plus energy (flat, blocked or seasonal).
structures.demand_tou: Demand billing with time-of-use energy or demand periods (reserved; unused).
structures.interruptible: Standard published interruptible service class with its own prices.

exclusions.pilot: Pilot or experimental schedule with limited or closed enrollment.
exclusions.optional_product: Optional add-on layered on a base tariff (green power, RNG blends, rentals, optional programs), not a standard rate.
exclusions.adjustment_or_rider_only: Rider, credit or adjustment applied to another tariff; no standalone price.
exclusions.conditional_only: Eligibility needs specific equipment (dual-energy, thermal storage), a load-factor or usage-pattern condition, or customer-specific assets; not the default class.
exclusions.off_grid_or_diesel: Isolated diesel/off-grid electricity or isolated propane systems.
exclusions.process_or_non_building: Process or non-building service (farm, irrigation, oil field, unmetered loads).
exclusions.generation_or_net_metering: Generation credits, net metering, self-generation or renewable access.
exclusions.standby: Standby or capacity reservation for self-generating customers.
exclusions.interruptible_special: Curtailable/interruptible credit option modifying another class.
exclusions.reference_only: Reference only (e.g. a schedule for one named customer).
exclusions.territory_planned_later: Territorial record (YT/NT/NU); territorial models are planned separately.
exclusions.delivery_only_alternative: Delivery- or transportation-only variant with marketer/retailer commodity at a private price, duplicating a full-service model.
exclusions.duplicate_variant: Another record of the same utility already represents this service (same-class branch, elective alternative for the same customers, special multi-unit classification).
exclusions.industrial_use_only: Added Oct 9: eligibility limited to industrial (manufacturing/processing/extraction) use; the general-service class represents the band.
exclusions.supply_voltage_alternative: Added Oct 9: class defined by supply voltage/pressure (transmission, sub-transmission, primary, mainline) or customer-owned transformation, an alternative to the standard class for the same load.
exclusions.residential_large_demand: Added Oct 9: residential service billed on demand for >= 50 kW residences; outside the residential usage levels, no residential demand model.
exclusions.service_fees: Added Oct 9: schedule of service fees, not a rate.
exclusions.province_not_modelled_yet_7c: Added Oct 9 (batch 12): Alberta electricity record (distribution/transmission wires or Rate of Last Resort energy). An Alberta all-in model needs a wires + Rate of Last Resort combination, planned for Phase 7C; reported here, not modelled yet.
exclusions.gas_models_phase_7d: Added Oct 9 (batch 12): Ontario or Alberta natural gas record (Enbridge Gas, EPCOR Natural Gas (Ontario), ATCO Gas). Gas usage levels, volume bands and commodity handling are planned for Phase 7D; reported here, not modelled yet.

zones.default: Standard/default zone or service area. Ontario: tariff code without zone suffix (Hydro One R1, GSe, GSd). Elsewhere: main interconnected, urban or mainland service.
zones.other: Another standard rate zone or location-assigned class of the same utility (Ontario '-<ZONE>' code suffix / '[zone]' name; Hydro One UR/R2/AR/AUR, UGe/AGSe/AUGe, UGd/AGSd/AUGd; rural, Labrador, Fort Nelson). Use is an engine option pending the user's choice: default zones only, or each multi-zone utility once as the median of its zones.

commercial_xlarge.label: >= 5,000 kW
commercial_xlarge.note: Reference 5,000 kW is the band floor, used only for band assignment; no usage level is defined yet.

size_band_rules: Electricity size_band is a list: a record contributes to each listed band (each utility counts once per band).

'@demand_bounds' = computed from demand_min_kw/demand_max_kw as [min, max): every band whose reference_kw lies in the range; if none, the band that contains the range; if none, every overlapping band. Used for Ontario demand classes, e.g. GS 50-4,999 kW -> medium + large, GS 50-999 kW -> medium, Large Use -> xlarge.
Elsewhere bands are set per rule from published eligibility; kVA limits use the 0.9 power factor in usage_levels.json (for example 110 kVA = 99 kW, 1,000 kVA = 900 kW).
Per usage level the engine uses only records whose eligibility covers that level's kW (and kWh, e.g. NSPower Rate 10 below 32,000 kWh/yr), then combines that utility's zones per the zone policy.

Gas size_band (provisional until Phase 7D): 'annual_volume:<min>-<max>:<unit>' copied from published annual-volume eligibility in native units (no m3/GJ conversion; empty max = no upper bound); null where no annual-volume eligibility is published (flagged REVIEW in the note).
